Also SCOPE: they used deduplicated data and excluded -999 baseline, which is appropriate per data dictionary. The estimand: highest response rate among sites. They used correct denominator (patients after dedup and valid). So scope fine. Grounding: they reported 0.705298 etc which matches output. Overreach: no causal claim, just descriptive. Caveats fine. UNACKNOWLEDGED DATA PROBLEMS: they handled -999 and duplicates. No other issues. So main defect is false premise: question mentions four sites but data only three; analyst didn't note mismatch. Should be revise.
